body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yF_2TiPDRVx9ILPYTJc031IBQJ6tJXxq38xzydt5cEO1at7Uso0mCPygjtSyyWZ7qyQOkfWkLWMOByprIVSSqbZlDimRezLNFbD4Zf1uUKbOu2RO4tSsVInSLPiKzd9oSMTw1KHdaYWxNaId-_Hwq7uE4YTod-zHhnlGREh6nIQK6Q0BNrtJJ320ec1_HbitJZ6lUYB3Y37qkJvgl9GJHigrWqasWZNaKMmmQRwyv4_fE%3D)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yFtF-R5ogMcaclIuH37l-c_8c4Fj859OsQ4Gon-GdcXWKYfRyMvsQiNwgteCB9mYxcMPgEeZrzqxfwckcfXaYLJ-XrWsxKkgk5DOgHra42Z87EmxfhS5198BdkBGXC8QVfZLRHIesMkf80LjHTLRgrkHvblqgDDS8PnSVdNOeAzWATTdGXuLyrlnOUxqPVqYjZIe52e7Dx6MCo8jDu7UY5kMYVPhVr5D3dPhwf_hlwXhI%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yF2vUvrPseyvUx2F4t-AQItNRWR5MzcXlGMSmsTbVW_W5wdFUHN-eD8B6k8Zdp5FEzUlOGuApEyasbhkMM7-z3Dxwmnycl_CZT9cf3kdz4Hy8KfJuekNj_DymofBAXwBLS5MY2pmfi5WD8T67O32p_YSbaWGDI6sDOKnFy5q2tLoQwa4bCMyXuK-lZfILSo8Dj1KD0-sX4TQJfSSMudNlCytDm2bgVCshpcpKQcPyEZjQ%3D)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yF1dd4sqgiMUaWnsx57RELxrxbHyEHxDvLd5MK4R2cWiNmjEILSho0GcIX7mA1h8RDleXXYJkB9kwtbnfpImKvqEpaEYkiyKK9vVdMtqwWBEVDkBCQH6dqenLv2e-UlbuI3oWYkIDl3z7hBdffmOrdfi64suslnvoZhOmHF335xv2S3ZzlG8ysvOYJl_FbUp0_AmmQmHK2ko_o0p-G6yjhpnVIHeQm3BeUP5xQT2-9hWY%3D)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yFJZU9h0CZvJ-QdfDPJStwt-VjMbEOxb4iOCiCG2MwMIzGg63CaPvd-ELIfVVvLxTz66X1JXPhcZXYTieHlEOFfrCUfduNYP17wLZGN8ot0NTSc6L3hP5mHFdEtVgUyYufMrv3p9Fnk5QAsm6XygfekSUTvvgZaZwsigbku-xW7rphKT32hwH7OwvJztG4DoB_3Tz-tFV1neQOjSmWA9zUnOSapd9ezYvmJf7DYL1JwKw%3D) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fd905c60c192483c9e0d40323b4ea83e&_e=YP_9xZkid6h-6sQZivkyojnT8wgOm78Sbaqk-ZxfWUDvBM5rSxNJuVht_f92hCHBRWrbVg1PF-g6H_cJFbv06zqVbzzsofOl8_l7l9rSAidFlMuRC8TvpYdjndinYCeZ-bB-TyWrky4IyvPKBGJfWVjq5i2QlgZjO3mCO6lu-GuGb9zlR7z0g7H4KRfJiNddzUkOR_S_2-0rW6MmB4XRDZfc4BIIzlTZEZlpReyrYGjmWTxnupkq3SDZyLqq59yFOLDqyc9Ws1HOKLJ689BHyyUnhGagI4zj7M2sg914X9e856-eUKMxj8vDIf-uzArOp01sVbdn_WGwGDkQHIiLHeK00xGOEguE7RjZq2g-ZfBOKZMl_EAjFAd3DXXxnD_Dha-VvEnfRBW8xxUTxqR6tsFZaUVlvMIrIO1zQg6mFXB18aWeIC59OKL_G0Nv3pgE6cII7BE0NXtWBxN_2P5L0uGcf4GrJ8q7cZIj4T0mz6w%3D)

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney! My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going. It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side. Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over you. Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and 60 Minutes lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump. Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners! But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters! As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. This is the time where we must write our own story of America, a time for defending civil rights and even ensuring our basic survival in the face of climate change. All of our hard fought progressive victories over the years could come down to what happens this election. = If Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and their MAGA Republicans get their way, they'll take our entire nation back to a time when women were second-class citizens, where the rights of workers barely existed, and where entire groups of Americans were systematically denied the freedom to vote. We can't let the MAGA Republicans write the next chapter in American history. We must forge our own path toward equality, opportunity and justice for all. And that's exactly why we're ready to work so hard this election to stop them. = Time to get organized, starting right here with our July fundraising deadline. 100 days to go.

Peter, the countdown is on: we’re 100 days out from Election Day. | | | | | Peter, With the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , many states are enacting abortion bans and criminalizing healthcare – threatening jail time to doctors for providing abortion. [**Add your name to stop the criminalization of abortion and support pro-choice candidates.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb3bb85c2-ac1d-4d01-925f-b8dfae3be557/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It is increasingly clear that local leaders like district attorneys and city councilors are our last line of defense in these attacks on our reproductive freedom as it will come down to them if and how to enforce healthcare criminalization. That’s why are calling for the election and support of pro-choice officials who are committed to ensuring that no doctor or patient is criminalized for giving or receiving life-changing or life-saving medical care.

body:
MN GOP is meddling in our race for CD 1. Party and District Chair alike are trying to roll out the red carpet for Brad Finstad. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeremymunson/breaking-i-am-running-for-congress-in-minnesotas-1st-district-9036433?e=f4c2e54596)
---
[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=25f1bff454&e=f4c2e54596)
Peter,I am worried about our country. This is why I am running and why I am asking for your vote in the August 9th Republican primary. With inflation sky high and another recession officially here, it is the time to elect fiscal conservatives, not big spenders who have worked as lobbyists and are beholden to the establishment and super PACs.While serving in the state house, my voting record earned me a reputation as a fiscal hawk who pointed out pork, waste and abuse in numerous programs and voted against multi-subject omnibus bills. I fought for our liberties and to follow the Constitution. My transparency about my fiscally conservative votes and how the process worked, often upset the establishment and big spending Republicans, because it allowed the people to better hold them accountable.We all knew when I got into this race that the MN GOP establishment had chosen Brad Finstad to fill the seat of my friend Jim Hagedorn. What we didn’t know is how far they would go.Back in April we held an endorsing convention for the New First Congressional District. A convention where they placed a Brad Finstad **DONOR** as the Convention Chairman, and where Aaron Farris, our District Chair, actively campaigned to **NOT ENDORSE**.As I reached 55% of the delegate vote, nearing the 60% threshold for endorsement, party leaders voted to not endorse. And Brad? He left with barely a third of the vote. They threw everything they had to prevent the grassroots from having a say in this election.Now they’re ramping up their suppression efforts to new levels. My campaign recently received a Cease and Desist from the State Party to stop talking with BPOU Chairs and activists who I have known long before my run for Congress.To top it off, the District Chair, told party volunteers, there would be repercussions for failing to support Brad Finstad in this election. They’re not even allowed to like a Munson post from their personal accounts. Clearly the MN GOP has been paying too much attention to how the DFL operates, because this is not how Conservatives work.The MN GOP is trying to intimidate and suppress our grassroots effort. The Establishment voted to have another endorsing convention for the new district, immediately after the special primary for the old district "to endorse the winner of the special primary." April was our chance to endorse a candidate and be united, but party “leaders” decided a fiscal conservative cannot win. Allowing a primary bought by DC SuperPACs to force the endorsement of the grassroots, is like Roundup to the grassroots.If we were Democrats this would be just another Sunday, but we are not. We believe in the right to vote, transparency, and the grassroots. Wabasha and Goodhue counties, new to the first district, were not even able to vote in the Special Primary.The primary August 9th is a new and different race. Unlike the special primary, where there were ten candidates and Brad received 38% of the vote and I received 37%, the primary on August 9th is only between Brad and I. With your help, we can win. Early voting has started. I am asking for your vote and I am asking you to ask your friends and family to also go vote Munson. Voter turnout is expected to be low, so every vote is important.[Help me show the Establishment that their corruption will not be tolerated by the grassroots.](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=216eb8f0c7&e=f4c2e54596)Donald Trump had to fight off attacks from the Establishment on his way to becoming one of the greatest Presidents of our lifetime, and now I’m having to fight off the same corrupt bureaucrats trying to suppress the grassroots.The MN GOP is trying to silence a legitimate primary, and we cannot allow the Establishment to coronate Brad Finstad because he’s willing to spend billions of taxpayer money and I am not.
Jeremy Munson
Candidate for Congress
Personal cell: (507) 200-8448

clean_body: Molly's credentials are like no other | Peter, This is the first time Vermont’s lone Congressional seat has been open since 2006. This primary election, we can choose our next generation of Democratic leadership. We have to get this right. With only two Senators and one Representative to meet the diverse needs of Vermont, Molly has the right experience to get the job done for our small, rural state. = Molly spent nearly a half decade working in and with Congress , first with Rep. Peter Welch and then with the International Committee of the Red Cross. As our Congresswoman, she won’t need on-the-job training. She is ready to deliver for Vermont on Day 1. Molly worked overseas to promote human rights and humanitarian assistance. She led field missions into complex environments including Haiti, the Western Balkans, Iraq and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Molly understands the role of congressional oversight and will advocate for smart foreign policy. Molly worked to uphold and protect fundamental rights , both as a federal law clerk and as a Vermont Assistant Attorney General. As a trained human rights lawyer, she will use her skills and experience to get to work codifying fundamental rights in Congress, including reproductive rights and equal marriage. Molly has served statewide as Vermont’s Lieutenant Governor , presiding over the Vermont Senate, giving Vermonters a seat at the table in Montpelier, and advocating tirelessly for the diverse needs of our communities from Pownal to Canaan and everywhere in between. Vermont has alway sent fighters to Washington, and Molly has worked for two of them — Senator Leahy and Representative Welch. Molly has the experience to get the job done, and she’ll work with anyone to do what’s right for Vermont. But she needs your help now. Tonight at midnight is our final end-of-month fundraising deadline ahead of our primary election that’s just a few weeks away. It’s the most important fundraising deadline of our campaign so far, because if we don’t reach it, we won’t have the resources we need to get our message out to voters and get out the vote.

We are only $3,169 away from our goal and any help you can give before midnight will make a real difference in this high-stakes election. What’s at stake? Too much to detail in this email, but I’ll give it a shot.

Women are facing attacks on our reproductive freedom, when we should have control over our own bodies and our own destiny without the threat of imprisonment. You can count on me to do everything I can to codify Roe into law as your next member of Congress. That’s why I’ve earned the endorsement of Her Bold Move.

Here in Florida and across the nation, gun violence in our communities is out of control — we need our next member of Congress to be someone who will fight to ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, and close background check loopholes. That’s why I’ve earned the Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate Distinction.

And our LGBTQ+ community needs more allies in Congress as they’ve come under increased attacks, especially here in Florida. That’s why I’ve earned the endorsement of the Palm Beach County Human Rights Council Voters Alliance, Florida’s oldest organization fighting for equal rights for the LGBTQ+ community.

I’ve fought to protect victims of crime and domestic violence as an Assistant State Attorney, and I’ve worked to root out hate at its source as the Director of the Florida Anti-Defamation League — I have the experience we need in our next member of Congress, and I’m someone you can trust to fight for progress.

Thank you for any help you can provide before midnight, friend.

This is a fight we must win.

— Hava

Friend -- I know you’ve been hearing a lot from me, so I promise to keep this short:

name: Ralph Rebandt For Governor
subject: Join Prayer Call Tonight!
body:
Pray with our team tonight at 9:30 PM

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayercallemail2&n=1)
---
**Join The Prayer Call Tonight** Dear Ralph Rebandt for Governor Team & Prayer Warriors We will be having prayers calls, join when you can! **Tonight, Sunday 9:30pm** **Call 605-313-4829** **Then enter 694177#** For anyone who would like to join in Praying and Fasting, we have a team that will be praying and fasting the entire day of the election. Here are some things that we can flood the throne of God with together, as we join together- \- Father, Son Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit, we acknowledge and glorify you as God, we give you Praise. \- We confess our shortcomings, and ask your forgiveness. \- We are SO THANKFUL Lord that you have brought us this far! \- Lord, Ralph meets the qualifications of whom You Lord have said you will look to in Isaiah 66. The one who is humble, contrite in spirit, and trembles at Your Word. Please Lord, as we your people ask in agreement, please listen to the voice of Your children in Michigan as we ask for our choice for Governor in Michigan to be Ralph Rebandt. Lord, the only reason we ask this so passionately of You is that we believe He is Your choice as he meets these qualifications. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven, Lord. We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. Ralph desires Psalm 138:2, "Your Name and Your Word you have elevated above all else." \- That the Holy Spirit would make up ALL the difference in our weaknesses in how we do not know how to pray- "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words." (Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! **Reminder - Ralph Rebandt for Governor Rally** **** If you are in the Grand Rapids area don't miss the Ralph Rebandt for Governor rally this Sunday with former Rep. Tom Hooker and Jim VanSteenhouse, "The Bear Man". This event is free of charge and we hope to see you there!
### **2 Days Until August 2nd!**
There is less than a week left in the Primary election and we have seen tremendous support in this last month. We are currently launching a special advertising campaign and are continuing to seek financial contributions that go directly to this advertising. If you would like your contribution to go to this campaign, donate $101, or any amount ending with a 1 such as $31, or $41. This will make it easy for us to direct your contribution properly. Please Consider donating or volunteering to help us make **Michigan a Lighthouse to The Nation.** | [](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/donate?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayercallemail2&n=2 "DONATE ANY AMOUNT") [DONATE ANY AMOUNT](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/donate?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayercallemail2&n=2)
---

Ralph Rebandt For Governor

We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. subject: We Need a Fighter To Beat Gretchen Whitmer
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MICHIGAN FOR RYAN D
body:
I am that fighter!
| | | |
---
---
| Peter,
We have reached a pivotal moment:
On Tuesday, August 2, we the people, get to choose which Republican we want to lead us to victory against our tyrannical governor.
Hundreds of thousands of volunteers have given their time, talent, and treasure to support their gubernatorial candidates.
Now, we come to a very important question:
---
---

Peter, I am the only candidate who can beat Gretchen Whitmer, because I am a FEARLESS, TIRELESS fighter!
I have been fighting for you, since the Covid tyranny began in 2020. Here are some ways I fought for you:

* Organized rallies to protest Gretchen's lockdowns.
* Met with the FBI to urge them to investigate Whitmer's crimes.
* Protected the Civil War statue in Allendale from being torn down by Antifa/BLM, and kept Allendale safe from leftist destruction.
* Helped organize the Nationwide Freedom March on October 24th.
* Helped organize and host three Stop the Steal rallies at the Michigan State Capitol Building, in the months of November and December of 2020.
* Attended and spoke at the Henry Ford Healthcare protest, in support of employees who refused the vaccines.
* Spoke at numerous anti-vaccine and medical freedom rallies.
* Supported and prayed with a group of people outside an abortion clinic in Grand Rapids

Vermont is not for sale, and now’s our chance to show the GOP we can’t be bought.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=734%2E61531%2Ei3amT4)
Hello,
With the primary election just nine days away, tonight's fundraising deadline is critical.
We’ve seen national Republicans start to accelerate their efforts to flip the Senate and retake the majority—and one place they’re placing a great deal of their efforts is here in Vermont.
I get it. This is an open seat, and the Senate majority is going to come down to the wire. The GOP is throwing a lot of money into races across the country to win back power—and they already have over $100 million in the bank to do it. No matter how regressive their policies or how harmful their ideas are, they firmly believe they can buy their way to victory. And we have every reason to think they’ll try to purchase this race.
Vermont is not for sale—never has been, never will be. So let’s prove it. [**This is our last end-of-month deadline before the primary, and we’ve got to make a statement with this one. If you’re able, please make a $5 contribution or whatever you can before midnight tonight.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3641?t=3&akid=734%2E61531%2Ei3amT4)

| Hey Peter, did you see Kevin’s email yesterday?

We’re working around the clock to build the resources we need to send Kevin to Congress in November. We know he is the progressive fighter we need to take on climate change, but we have less than 24 hours left to hit our end of month goal.

[Can you rush a donation of $30, $50, $150, or whatever you can give before midnight?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=26ccc8896f&e=292fde286a)

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Kevin Mullin** <kevin@kevinmullinforcongress.com>
Date: Sat, Jul 30, 2022 at 4:48 PM
Subject: It’s go time for bold climate action
To: Peter Willis <dpwillis67@gmail.com>
---
| | | Dear Peter,

It’s another summer with yet another dangerous wildfire burning tens of thousands of acres right in our own backyard, and experts are already calling the _Oak Fire_ California’s largest wildfire of the year so far. Over 3,000 residents have been evacuated and the sad reality is that many won’t have homes to return to once the blaze is extinguished.

**Bottom line: Climate change is only worsening the threat of wildfires, and we need bold climate action – now -– to protect our planet for future generations.**

[Peter, if you’re ready to send a climate champion and proven progressive to Congress to fight for a _Green New Deal_ with a robust jobs training program, click here to chip in whatever you can to my campaign.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=47b3178ced&e=292fde286a)

As Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I passed a $3.7 billion package to combat climate change, authored the bill to create _OneShoreline_ to fight sea level rise, and helped secure the largest climate investment in California history. I pushed for clean-energy transit initiatives like _CalTrain_ electrification and zero-emission buses and wrote the _Climate Resilience Bond_ to protect our natural resources.

In Congress, I am ready to build on these accomplishments and prioritize passing a _Green New Deal_ to safeguard our planet for future generations and reduce emissions while also strengthening the American workforce with good-paying, middle-class, union jobs in the clean energy sector.

[But I need your help to get there, and my campaign has only one day left to hit our July fundraising goal. Will you help us before this critical deadline with a gift of $30, $50, or $150 today?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=66ba0f029c&e=292fde286a)

Onward,

Kevin Mullin

### Turning a page to a new chapter in my life

I'm grateful for the chance to share a few thoughts and updates in a new format.
Having fallen [less than 600 votes short](https://substack.com/redirect/e59be4d1-69de-4ce4-af52-0d7ae8b2cc4f?u=90501192) of the general election in last month's jungle primary, I'm even more grateful to be liberated from the corrupt cesspool of electoral politics and to finally have the chance to return to my life. Thanks for walking that road with me, and for any support you might have offered our campaigns to challenge corruption in Congress and enable better public policy! I hope to stay connected as I seek other ways to serve.
Thanks for reading my newsletter! Subscribe for free to receive new posts, featuring analysis and culture you won't find elsewhere.

Below, I'll share a few updates from the life to which I'm returning, as well as a few reflections and resources relating to politics. Come for the analysis, stay for the beats!
### **Back to life**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a1ab2b-e353-413a-87cd-462b1cc00221?u=90501192)
Long before I ever contemplated running for office, I found satisfaction in sharing my creative voice as a [poet](https://substack.com/redirect/72a3765b-99af-4bb2-a463-a47562c54f2c?u=90501192), [singer](https://substack.com/redirect/6e798bdc-754e-4fe2-b373-ca7627871a57?u=90501192), [DJ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab2fa17b-d7c1-467e-a765-0fe8f60caa0d?u=90501192), and [MC](https://substack.com/redirect/9e7b2263-bb9b-4cbe-ac14-2e591814893f?u=90501192). This month has offered plenty of chances to step back into my old shoes:
* I DJ every month at Madrone Art Bar in the Lower Haight every second Wednesday. This month, after our final volunteer appreciation gathering on July 13, I ended up playing a 6 hour set! It was a memorable way to wrap up the campaign and kick off an early birthday celebration.
* My first DJ set ever in San Jose brought me to Caravan Lounge last Thursday, July 28. Thanks to everyone who came out, and to the venue & staff for hosting us!
* Earlier this month, I also played my first DJ sets at two different clubs in San Francisco: Petit Paris in North Beach on Saturday, July 2, and Butter in SoMa on Wednesday, July 6. Thanks to DJ Oiwa for bringing me on!
* Every Thursday night since July 2003, there's been an [outdoor open mic](https://substack.com/redirect/4d178cb1-4b6f-4a28-a851-291d35c57a75?u=90501192) at the corner of 16th & Mission that I co-founded with a handful of friends, featuring poetry, song, and comedy. Joining the crew again (twice!) this month felt like returning home.

My music & poetry have always found inspiration in political dysfunction and dystopia. I hope, in this next phase of my life, to focus more attention on their intersections. To whit:
* I'm putting together an EP that I hope to release later this year with tracks including [Ferguson to Jerusalem](https://substack.com/redirect/c0358c8f-7b1e-4d80-a32b-94ecd31dafb0?u=90501192), [Justice](https://substack.com/redirect/f6f14dcb-4d35-4859-a3dc-f2547b3a6534?u=90501192), and either [NSA vs USA](https://substack.com/redirect/8f8b80a9-4f81-42fb-a49b-25402369af27?u=90501192), or instead a new track on which I'm working now that is both a history lesson and a CIA diss track.
* I've started working on a book of poetry that I hope to self-publish later this year or next. It reflects my political voice, as well as parts of my vision well beyond politics, from the longing for justice that has animated my work, to my words for my mother before we lost her to cancer.

Want to hear revolutionary music and poetry before their public release? Stay tuned!
### **Back to reality**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/465b6a6d-42aa-42b6-8bca-494c07764298?u=90501192)
Democrats are crowing about a [toothless](https://substack.com/redirect/24a22d41-9d6b-47ca-8888-dae3a8711a95?u=90501192) and [inadequate](https://substack.com/redirect/178aa1d6-64f6-4cb2-a59d-fb1bd6c4b182?u=90501192) climate bill, celebrating yet another performative contrivance while the future literally burns. >From catastrophic [floods](https://substack.com/redirect/d6f10b87-079e-4cd5-bec6-ec77142d48ee?u=90501192) in the Midwest to historic heatwaves in the [Cascades](https://substack.com/redirect/04ac27b5-9233-4a24-ba91-ad22e3883b40?u=90501192) and [Europe](https://substack.com/redirect/b164fb49-33fb-4b9d-86e4-9d6fb9f9f30a?u=90501192), the impacts of the Anthropocene reveal themselves with increasing clarity every day. Figures celebrating the new climate compromise, such as the notoriously co-opted Sen. Joe Manchin (WV), [claim](https://substack.com/redirect/231487fc-8580-4f84-a921-cbf37e1591c6?u=90501192) to see progress in what ultimately amounts to resignation.
Meanwhile, Biden is [completing](https://substack.com/redirect/c752260d-885d-4381-a9f6-9067d09b82a1?u=90501192) the Trump-Pelosi border wall. Vote harder!
Finally, Pelosi's [visit to Asia](https://substack.com/redirect/91f22704-51aa-4046-b932-1b3425a08810?u=90501192) and plans to visit Taiwan offered a needless provocation that could easily escalate into yet another pretext for a potential world war. It offers the latest demonstration of disregard for the national security of Americans, and corrupt fealty to a weapons industry whose interests have long undermined actual U.S. national security. At a time when the Pentagon is already stoking the fires of an armed conflict with another nuclear power, it is beyond senseless to needlessly [provoke](https://substack.com/redirect/8492456f-2424-494e-baf2-c5ec317de167?u=90501192) yet another one.
While diversifying my projects to include more art, I am still pursuing two goals related to politics that might interest you.
1. The first entails shifting our campaign operation to a political action committee, to continue informing supporters about policy issues and campaigns poised to address them. Three candidates who we hope to support going forward face primary elections in Washington State this Tuesday, August 2: [Rebecca Parson](https://substack.com/redirect/056ec17a-ecb1-41f5-879f-849599dea97a?u=90501192), [Jason Call](https://substack.com/redirect/052a9fd6-e2c1-4172-b719-a3c257be2ebf?u=90501192), and [Stephanie Gallardo](https://substack.com/redirect/8b548107-015f-4758-ba74-9e48361b506f?u=90501192). Each of them joined the Left Coast Alliance earlier this year in a [shared response](https://substack.com/redirect/c3cbf69c-548e-4912-892d-620c13038c71?u=90501192) to the Pentagon's latest bipartisan warmongering. Please support them, and stay tuned on how you can support other downballot candidates through our PAC!
2. Second, our [federal lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/7c01f69e-08c0-4542-bec6-80779cb77007?u=90501192) continues to defend election integrity from the San Francisco Chronicle's [malicious and reckless publication of racist lies](https://substack.com/redirect/cc4880e8-d197-45bb-a63b-38a950ab9d5f?u=90501192) fabricated in 2020 to mislead voters. In addition to seeking support for our legal expenses, we're also recruiting support for amicus briefs from third parties to inform the court about the public interests supporting our claims, including election integrity and anti-discrimination principles. If you'd like to get involved, please ask me how since there are several opportunities!

### Back to the here and now
[](https://substack.com/redirect/51d9f7df-ee15-4b02-99ae-106c2fd54a40?u=90501192)
Now that I'm no longer running for office, I hope to continue offering political education, while limiting its role in my life to allow more space for my self.
Having done everything a single person possibly can to defend the future--and frankly, with the help of tens of thousands of supporters, much more than merely that--I'm grateful for the excuse to redirect my focus and place more attention on my immediate sphere. My goals include recovering some space for my own goals and joy after decades of dedicating my time to concerns well beyond me, but I remain eager to share what I've learned and will continue to publish updates from time to time.
I'll look forward to your questions and insights! Don't be shy.
Your friend,
Shahid
PS -- Shout out to [Soul II Soul](https://substack.com/redirect/b789f030-2530-45e1-9267-987524d658d6?u=90501192)!

body:
No matter which Republican makes it through the primary next Tuesday, I'll be up against a pro-Trump, anti-choice opponent. Peter,

Tuesday is Primary Election Day in Washington state. With control of the House majority hinging on this race, I wanted to take a moment to share why we can't afford for any of my Republican opponents to be sent to Congress.

No matter which Republican makes it through the primary next Tuesday, I'll be up against a pro-Trump, anti-choice opponent, who will go along with Kevin McCarthy’s extreme agenda in Congress if they flip this seat red. With everything from defending a woman’s right to choose, to reducing gun violence, to lowering costs for families on the line, we can't afford to let that happen.

This will be my toughest race yet. Election experts are saying Washington's 8th District is a "toss up," and _Fox News_ called my seat one of 10 House seats most likely to flip. National Republicans are taking this as a sign they can defeat me this November, and they're spending millions of dollars to attack me.

Once our primary is over, national Republicans and outside groups will line up behind my opponent and spend whatever it takes to defeat me. We just have 100 days left before the general election in November, so I need your help to ensure we're prepared to fight back.

Kim

name: Team AOC
subject: Our rulebook for sending you an email
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We’re not going to beg, scare, or guilt-trip.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220731-3262-header&t=1&akid=3262%2E2526796%2EuQuMcw)
Tonight is a big end-of-month fundraising deadline for many campaigns, so we’re guessing your inbox might look something like this:
Senate Polling Update please?!?!?! 8:04 AM
---
DEMOCRAT ALERT [5x match pending] ⚠️ ⚠️ 7:38 AM
Rep. Jane Doe I’m begging you: 6:12 AM
It’s sad how so many politicians and organizations treat their supporters like ATMs — especially before big deadlines.
This shouldn’t set us apart, but Team AOC is committed to treating you and your fellow supporters with respect. That means we follow some (we think!) pretty basic rules:
* **NO** to panicky subject lines, fear mongering, fake donor matches, clickbait petitions, or basically any tactic that makes you want to hit the “report spam” button.
* **YES** to sharing volunteer opportunities and emergency funds, supporting up-and-coming progressive candidates, providing informative content, sending out real petitions with real targets, and (only when we need it) respectfully asking for your donation.

Today is one of the days where we’re going to ask you to give, if you can. We have our own end-of-month fundraising deadline, and like a lot of campaigns, donations to emails like this one are a top source of revenue.
But we’re not going to beg, scare, or guilt-trip. In fact, our goal isn’t even a dollar amount — **it’s 15,000 grassroots donations before midnight.** No matter if you give $1, $10, or $100, you’ll be helping support the movement we’ve been building since Alexandria’s election in 2018.
[We’d be so grateful if you made a donation before our midnight deadline. We’re less than 2,000 donations from our goal!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220731.P4E5hO&refcode=em20220731-3262-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3262%2E2526796%2EuQuMcw)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220731.P4E5hO&refcode=em20220731-3262-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3262%2E2526796%2EuQuMcw)**
And if today’s not the day for you to give, that’s completely OK, too. We’re just so glad you’re a part of this movement.
\- Team AOC

Time is almost up, Fellow American.

**_Our July end-of-month deadline is at midnight,_** and we need your help to fight off the growing progressive movement and their tightening grip on America.

VOTE BETWEEN TODAY AND 8/2 | | |
---
| | Good afternoon Freedom Fighters,

When you’re voting for President in 2024, who do you want Arizona’s Chief Elections Officer to be??

In 2020, Arizona’s electoral vote was a critical blow to President Trump’s re-election campaign to protect America from a horribly disastrous Biden-Harris administration. In 2020, Democrat Secretary of State Katie Hobbs and Maricopa County Recorder Adrian Fontes separately worked to rig our elections. They put their finger on the scale and are responsible for the calamity of 2020 and the Biden administration. They used the pandemic to try to change our election laws. Fontes tried to mail out a ballot to all voters for the presidential preference election; Hobbs pushed for same day voter registration leading up to the November election, putting her at odds with 10 of the state’s 15 county recorders from both parties, the election officials who actively must process the new registrations.

In 2024, if you want fair elections where your vote counts, Arizonans need a strong candidate that’s tough on election integrity, has a flawless conservative track record, and has the right skillset to run fair and secure elections. I’m the only one that matches that description. I’m the most electable candidate who can defeat the Democrat nominee come November. I have the best shot of defeating whoever the Dems throw our way in November.

That’s why I’m reaching out to you one last time. With your help, your vote on August 2nd will help decide the future of elections in Arizona.

If you haven’t voted, here’s how you can get in and vote today.

HOW TO VOTE
* If you received an early ballot and still have your ballot, **do _not_ mail it in**. Hand it in at [your local voting center](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5aed628e08&e=a7ab36849c) between now and 8/2.
* Bring a valid government issued ID that includes your name, photo, and the address where you are registered to vote. A valid, up-to-date Arizona driver’s license will work.
* Vote for Shawnna Bolick for Secretary of State!
* Afterwards you can [click here to “Check Your Status”](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d3480b227f&e=a7ab36849c) and see where your vote is in the processing system.

With this much at stake, we can’t take any chances. Reach out to your like-minded conservative friends and family today and ask them if they’ve voted. If they haven’t, **forward them this email and encourage them to vote for Shawnna Bolick for Secretary of State**.

I’m energized by your support and deeply grateful. The team we’ve built in the primary is going to roll over the Democrats in November. I’m confident we can prevail.

For Arizona,
